name: Governed Scale Assurance Dashboard and Audit Pack
objective: Provide a standards-aware assurance surface that separates operational signals, environmental evidence, DMRV state, control effectiveness and disclosure-ready climate/ESG data without converting dashboard status into certification, environmental truth or product release.

principles: Every material metric displays reporting boundary, period, unit, evidence class, source/method and status.
Observed, forecast, modelled, satellite, calculated and proxy data remain visually and semantically distinct.
Aggregate values retain source lineage and never silently convert missing data to zero.
Disclosure mappings are shown as alignment/mapping status, not standards certification.
Climate/GHG metrics expose scope, organizational/operational boundary, methodology, activity data, emission factor and uncertainty where applicable.
Every assurance conclusion links to evidence, reviewer scope/period and exception state.
Material unresolved exceptions block claim promotion and are visible at the point of use.
Administrative coverage is never presented as physical harvest or environmental performance.

ifrs_s2.measurement_rule: GHG emissions measurement method, inputs and assumptions must be explicit; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard is the default measurement basis unless an applicable jurisdiction requires another method.

standards: Product Standard where product life-cycle analysis is applicable

esrs_e1.note: Use current applicable ESRS requirements and jurisdictional adoption status. The 2026 revised ESRS Delegated Act is the current adopted reference in the EFRAG Knowledge Hub; earlier technical advice/draft material is not represented as adopted requirements.

fail_closed: missing unit or reporting period for quantitative metric
GHG scope claimed without supporting methodology and source lineage
unresolved material exception supporting a promoted claim
stale or incompatible methodology/version without documented change control
administrative reporting grid represented as physical harvest site
forecast/model output presented as measured observation
anchor presented as proof of environmental truth
claims_boundary: This surface supports standards-aware data preparation, lineage, reconciliation and assurance review. It does not itself constitute IFRS, ESRS, GHG Protocol, regulatory, laboratory, assurance or product certification.
